blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The University of Cebu Lapu-Lapu and Mandaue (UCLM) Webmasters dethroned the mighty University of San Jose-Recoletos (USJ-R) Lady Jaguars in the finals of the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26 secondary girls’ volleyball tournament on Sunday, November 15, at the Minglanilla Sports Complex. The Lady Webmasters stunned the defending champions in four sets, 25-20, 19-25, 25-22, 25-16, to capture their first Cesafi girls’ volleyball crown. They put an end to the Lady Jaguars’ three-year championship reign, denying the latter a historic four-peat.
